Name: Saturation Doom Loop
Pathway: Employment stress → Workers flood TO gig (Goldman: 20% of layoffs) → Oversupply → Earnings decline (50-65% of prior pay) → Hours increase → Financial stress → Auto loan DQ → Economic contraction → More employment stress
Mechanism: Reinforcing feedback loop. Gig economy cannot absorb unlimited supply — saturation compresses earnings for ALL workers. JOLTS 0.91 inverted + LFPR 61.9% = workers being pushed out of traditional employment.
Feedback Loops: Self-reinforcing: more entrants → lower earnings → more stress → economic contraction → more entrants
Breakpoint: Gig earnings fall below subsistence for full-time workers
Notes: UPGRADED Apr 2026 — Goldman confirms 20% layoff→gig, CNN confirms driver quitting. JOLTS 0.91 is the trigger.

Name: Vehicle Asset Cascade
Pathway: Gig earnings decline → Deferred maintenance → Accelerated depreciation → Underwater on loan (52.9% already) → Miss payments OR exit gig → Auto default OR income loss
Mechanism: Vehicles are both productive asset and liability. High-mileage use accelerates depreciation faster than loan paydown. 52.9% already underwater.
Feedback Loops: Exit reduces income, which increases loan stress
Breakpoint: Widespread negative equity in gig worker vehicles

Name: Platform Extraction Spiral
Pathway: Profitability pressure → Take rates +33% → Bonuses eliminated → Earnings lag fares (+4.1% vs +9.6%) → Best workers exit → Service quality declines → Customer demand declines → More pressure
Mechanism: Investor pressure forces extraction from workers. Triggers adverse selection — best workers with alternatives leave first. 2025 data confirms.
Feedback Loops: Quality decline → demand decline → revenue pressure → more cuts
Notes: UPGRADED Apr 2026 — take rate data confirms extraction. Bonuses near-eliminated.

Name: Gig-to-CARL Transmission
Pathway: Gig worker stress → Spending contraction → Credit utilization ↑ → Auto loan stress → Broader consumer credit deterioration → CARL vectors trigger
Mechanism: Gig workers are ~5-10% of labor force but leading indicator. Stress transmits through spending, credit, auto, and sentiment. 7M undercounted in stats.
Feedback Loops: Credit stress limits spending recovery options
Breakpoint: Gig stress visible in CARL credit metrics
Notes: UPGRADED — 4 vectors now CRITICAL (emergency loans, cash advance, bills delayed, take rates). Transmission lag says Q2-Q3 2026.

Name: AV Displacement Amplifier
Pathway: Waymo/Tesla expansion → Rideshare demand served by robots (500K rides/wk) → Human drivers lose rides → Oversupply worsens → Drivers with car loans trapped (asset trap) → Auto DQ spike in AV cities
Mechanism: AV displaces ~4,000 equiv full-time drivers currently. Accelerating with 20+ new cities planned. Compounds FLOW-GIG-01 oversupply.
Feedback Loops: AV growth → less demand for humans → more oversupply → lower earnings → more auto DQ
Breakpoint: AV captures >5% of total rideshare volume in deployment cities
Notes: NEW Apr 2026 — 3,000 robotaxis, $16B raised. Displacement math: 500K rides/wk ÷ 125 rides/driver/wk = ~4K equiv.

Name: Gas Squeeze Transmission
Pathway: Gas $4+ → Fill-up costs +43% ($35→$50) → Driver net income -15-20% → Drivers quit (CNN "I'm done") OR drive more hours → If quit: gig supply drops but personal income crisis → If stay: stress deepens
Mechanism: Direct cost pass-through. Platforms NOT absorbing gas costs. Fuel incentives reach <15% of drivers. At $4.50, delivery unprofitable in suburbs.
Feedback Loops: Higher gas → driver exits → temporary supply correction → BUT personal income crisis for exiters
Notes: NEW Apr 2026 — CNN confirms driver quitting statements. Fill-up +43%. Only 1 of 6+ drivers knew about fuel incentives.
